best_rules_serialized.name: academic_titles
best_rules_serialized.description: Matches names preceded by academic/professional titles, ensuring full name capture including suffixes (LL.M., MA, etc.) and excluding street names or partial matches.

best_rules_serialized.name: salutation_herr_frau
best_rules_serialized.description: Matches names following 'Herr' or 'Frau', strictly requiring a second capitalized word (surname) to avoid matching nouns like 'Einkünfte'.

best_rules_serialized.name: represented_by
best_rules_serialized.description: Matches names following 'vertreten durch', strictly requiring a full name structure and excluding company names or job titles without names.

best_rules_serialized.name: beschwerdesache_name
best_rules_serialized.description: Matches names following 'in der Beschwerdesache' or 'in der Sache', capturing full names including suffixes (Bakk. iur., MA, etc.), hyphenated names, and multi-part names.

best_rules_serialized.name: genitive_name_no_title
best_rules_serialized.description: Matches names following genitive articles (des, der, die) in contexts like 'Beschwerde des [Name]', strictly excluding authorities and organizations.

best_rules_serialized.name: role_anchor_name
best_rules_serialized.description: Matches names following role anchors like 'Richterin', 'Richter', etc., capturing the full name even without a title, ensuring it's not followed by a company or authority.

best_rules_serialized.name: initial_only_name
best_rules_serialized.description: Matches initial-only names (e.g., 'M.M.A.', 'M.') in contexts where a person is referenced but no full name is given.

best_rules_serialized.name: standalone_name_after_role
best_rules_serialized.description: Matches names that appear immediately after a role anchor (e.g., 'Richterin', 'Richter') without a title, capturing the full name.
